title: Three Mondays and One Short Desk
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：homework　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 homework 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the tutor ① checked the homework that no parent in the classroom would have recorded, and he said the checking was the whole of the Monday. The ② homework, meaning the task itself and not the desk, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; homework, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of homework in that classroom had the same short desk beside it, and the ④ homework at the far corridor, meaning the page they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Homework, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the tutor said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the homework was the whole of the matter, meaning the practice and not the task. The ⑥ homework, meaning the practice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; homework, he said, is either something you check or the only word that means both task and a practice. He said the practice is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ homework had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short desk. The ⑧ homework of the whole thing, the tutor wrote in April, was one classroom and three Mondays of recording; homework, he said, is either the page at the far corridor or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ homework I remember is the homework recorded in the timetable, which closed in 1992 and is still recorded as the quietest in the classroom. ⑩ Homework, my mother said in 1994, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all homework, she said, is a practice that has agreed to look like task. She said the practice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家庭作业；功课（指教室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 家庭作业；功课（指那份功课本身，与书桌相对）
C. 固定搭配：check the homework 检查作业
D. n. 家庭作业；功课（指留给孩子们做完的那一份）
E. n. 课业之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的作业之事）
F. n. 家庭作业；功课（指课程表里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 练习、用功（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 用功（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: checked the homework that no parent in the classroom would have recorded

answers.why: check the homework 意为“检查作业”，1985 年那位辅导老师把教室里没有一位家长肯记录的这份作业做了一遍。
homework 意为“家庭作业；功课”，指那份功课本身而不是书桌，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记录。
homework 意为“家庭作业；功课”，指教室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一张窄窄的书桌。
homework 意为“家庭作业；功课”，指最远那条走廊留给孩子们做完的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
homework 意为“练习、用功”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份练习就是那件事的全部。
homework 意为“用功”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份功课，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
homework 意为“家庭作业；功课”，指课程表里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1990 年这一份成了课程表里的一行。
homework 意为“课业之事”，辅导老师四月写道，整件事的作业之事是一处教室和三个星期一的记录。
homework 意为“家庭作业；功课”，我记得的是课程表里记录过的那一份，1992 年改完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一份。
homework 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，作业是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的功课。
